[Issue #9382] SOAP/Proxy: BaseSOAPSchema - add hide_input_in_errors=True to the model_config (#9427)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes for #9382  

## Changes proposed

- Updated base.py to add `hide_input_in_errors=True` to `model_config`
- Deleted legacy_soap_api_schemas.py as it was unused
- Updated test_legacy_soap_api_schemas.py to add tests for hidden input
in errors

## Context for reviewers

The errors being raised by the validation in the SOAPSchemas potentially
have PII in them. We want to obscure that information by adding
`hide_input_in_errors` flag to the `BaseSOAPSchema`, and also remove the
unused schema.

## Validation steps

Confirm tests pass. Also, verify that the input is not shown when
logging an error.

getting New Relic error alerts for missing fields.

[Issue #6876] automatically include x-sgg-token header for authorized fetch calls (#9337)

This change:

* introduces functionality to automatically add the necessary X-SGG-Token header to all API requests that require authentication
* applies that functionality to application related API requests

Note that this change does not update all authenticated fetch calls, will complete this work in a follow up PR. All existing calls should still work using the old manual system until they are translated over to the new system.

As part of this work I produced an audit of all authenticated calls, which can be found here
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T23xaq6AMl7qi6OErAzGFRHXs2TjGe-vVI5S9ImdtSs/edit?usp=sharing

A follow up ticket has been created for cleaning up some unrelated standardization issues discovered when performing the audit https://github.com/HHS/simpler-grants-gov/issues/9373

Fetcher helpers file cleaned up a bit so that files that just want to import the types it exported don't opt in to session related stuff.
